name: DB_TYPE
description: Database engine for Keycloak (postgres or sqlite)

name: KC_PROXY
description: Proxy header mode: 'edge' for Railway's terminate-all-TLS proxy, 'passthrough' when behind another TLS terminator

name: KC_HTTP_ENABLED
description: Set true to enable Keycloak HTTP mode (default port 8080); set false for HTTPS mode (port 8443)

name: KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_USERNAME
description: Initial admin username for Keycloak Admin Console login

name: KEYCLOAK_ADMIN_PASSWORD
description: Initial admin password. Must be at least 12 characters.

name: KEYCLOAK_HOSTNAME
description: The public hostname of the deployed Keycloak instance (without protocol)
